visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a yellow baseball cap and a blue denim button-down shirt over a white t-shirt stands in the aisle of a commercial airplane. He holds a small white slip of paper, presumably a boarding pass, and scans the cabin with a wide-eyed, bewildered facial expression. A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige hoodie and carrying a brown cross-body bag with a yellow charm, stands closely behind him looking confused. (2) The scene cuts to an older man in a blue polo shirt seated in a spacious, modern business-class pod. He is lifting a clear plastic cup to his mouth, drinking comfortably while seated in a plush white and grey chair. The lighting is bright and even. (3) The camera returns to the young man in the yellow cap, whose expression has shifted to one of utter shock and disappointment. He stares forward as if witnessing something unbelievable. (4) Another cut reveals an older woman in a black top sitting in the business-class seat directly behind the older man. She is focused on eating a snack and appears completely relaxed in the premium cabin environment. (5) The young couple begins to walk further down the plane's aisle toward the economy section. The woman places a hand on the man's arm as they move past the luxurious seats toward the more crowded rear of the aircraft.
